data.long_meaning: The name Sinan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sina' which means 'moon'. This name is associated with the divine power of the moon and evokes a sense of calmness, tranquility, and serenity. The name Sinan carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Telugu. Parents who choose Sinan usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered to be a symbol of the god 'Chandra'. The name Sinan is believed to carry the blessings of this deity and is often given to children born during the night or during the lunar phase.
